اعتنقتما (form VIII)
# اِعْتَنَقْتُمَا (iʕtanaqtumā) /iʕ.ta.naq.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# اُعْتُنِقْتُمَا (uʕtuniqtumā) /uʕ.tu.niq.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
